verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI's first-party docs describe an official CLI, `clai`, for chatting with various LLMs from the command line. It can also be launched from any Agent instance via `Agent.to_cli_sync()` and can spin up a browser chat server, and a probe confirms the dedicated CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of `clai` itself, and documentation depth on scripting or non-interactive automation usage for AI-native workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Pydantic AI comes with a CLI, clai (pronounced “clay”). You can use it to chat with various LLMs and quickly get answers, right from the command line
you can directly launch CLI mode from an Agent instance using Agent.to_cli_sync().
spin up a uvicorn server to chat with your Pydantic AI agents from your browser.
